name: field-design-system
description: Field Design System: Precision-crafted, dark-first design system with React client libraries, interactive sticker sheet, and theme editor.

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/tokens run build && npm --prefix packages/react run build && npm run docs:manifest && npm --prefix apps/showcase run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/tokens run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/react run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/showcase run typecheck
scripts.yalc:tokens: npm run build --workspace=@sam.barfield/field-tokens && npm --workspace=@sam.barfield/field-tokens exec -- yalc push
scripts.yalc:react: npm run build --workspace=@sam.barfield/field-react && npm --workspace=@sam.barfield/field-react exec -- yalc push
scripts.yalc:all: npm run yalc:tokens && npm run yalc:react
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/tokens run build && npm --prefix packages/react run build

author: Field Design Team
